package.name: sqlite3
package.installation: Built-in to Python (sqlite3), Node.js 22+ (node:sqlite), Android, iOS, and macOS

documentation.overview: SQLite is a C-language library that implements a small, fast, self-contained, high-reliability, full-featured, SQL database engine. It is the most used database engine in the world, embedded in billions of mobile devices and applications.
documentation.purpose: Local application storage, offline mobile persistence, embedded device databases, and lightweight desktop application storage without server management.
documentation.installation: Native binary or built-in engine runtime. In Node.js: `import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';`
documentation.configuration: Optimal performance requires enabling Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and foreign keys: `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;`
documentation.security_considerations: Never concatenate unsanitized user strings into SQL queries. Always use parameterized statements (`?` or named parameters) to prevent SQL injection.
documentation.error_handling: Handle `SQLITE_BUSY` when concurrent writes contend for the database lock by setting `PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;`

symbols.name: PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL
symbols.description: Switches SQLite from rollback journal mode to Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), allowing concurrent readers while a write transaction is active.

symbols.name: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE USING fts5
symbols.syntax: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE table_name USING fts5(column1, column2, tokenize='unicode61');
symbols.description: Creates an FTS5 full-text search virtual table enabling BM25 ranked fast text search queries.

parameters.name: tokenize
parameters.description: Tokenizer strategy, such as unicode61, porter, or trigram.

examples.title: Configuring High-Performance SQLite
examples.description: Enabling WAL mode, foreign keys, and busy timeout in Node.js.

pipelines.name: Zero-Downtime SQLite Setup Pipeline
pipelines.description: Step-by-step procedure for initializing production-grade embedded SQLite storage.
pipelines.objective: Prevent database lockouts, protect against data corruption, and ensure relational integrity.

steps.title: Open Database Connection
steps.explanation: Instantiate the database connection file handle.

steps.title: Enable Foreign Key Constraints
steps.explanation: Foreign key enforcement is disabled by default in SQLite for backward compatibility. Always enable it immediately after opening.

steps.title: Enable Write-Ahead Logging (WAL)
steps.explanation: WAL allows concurrent read operations while writes execute, improving transaction throughput significantly.

steps.title: Set Busy Timeout
steps.explanation: Ensure that if a lock collision occurs, the query sleeps and retries for up to 5000ms instead of immediately throwing SQLITE_BUSY.
